slides.title: The Last Light
slides.story:
The ferry was due at six, but by half past five the fog had swallowed the harbor. Maya stood at the ticket office, clutching a paper bag of oranges for her grandmother. The last bus had left an hour ago; the next one would not come until morning.

“You can wait inside,” said the old man behind the counter. He was polishing a brass bell that had not rung for years. “Or you can take the path along the cliff. It is shorter, but you must go now, while there is still light.”

Maya looked at the darkening sky. Then she looked at the bell. “Why don’t you ring it?” she asked. “Someone might come.”

The old man smiled. “I have been waiting for someone to ask me that.”

She stepped outside. The fog was lifting, just a little, and far below, a light moved across the water.

slides.title: 六个问题，锚定这个故事

items.label: 人物 WHO
items.text: Maya：给外婆送橘子的女孩；老人：售票亭的职员。
items.evidence: “clutching a paper bag of oranges for her grandmother”

items.label: 事件 WHAT
items.text: 雾遮住了港口；六点的渡轮可能来不了；Maya 必须在等待和悬崖小路之间选择。
items.evidence: “The ferry was due at six, but … the fog had swallowed the harbor.”

items.label: 时空
items.text: 傍晚，起雾的小港口售票亭，六点之前。
items.evidence: “by half past five the fog had swallowed the harbor”

items.label: 原因 WHY
items.text: Maya 想赶到外婆家；老人希望有人问起那只铃——也希望有人连接。
items.evidence: “I have been waiting for someone to ask me that.”

items.label: 写法 HOW
items.text: 第三人称有限视角；安静、克制的氛围；线索是小物件，不是解释。
items.evidence: “a brass bell that had not rung for years”

items.label: 冲突 CONFLICT
items.text: 时间（六点的渡轮）与安全（雾中的悬崖小路）；沉默与连接（铃声）。
items.evidence: “you must go now, while there is still light.”

slides.title: 一个可能的 P1
slides.label: 一个可能的版本——比较，不要照抄
slides.text: Maya took the path along the cliff, one hand against the cold stone wall. The fog moved in slow ribbons, now hiding the sea, now opening a narrow window of grey water. She counted her steps to keep her breathing steady. Then, behind her, the brass bell broke the silence—once, twice, three times. She stopped. Below, a beam of light swept across the harbor and held, waiting. She began to run.
highlights: one hand against the cold stone wall
notice: 身体动作表现情绪；句子不直接命名情绪。
铃和光在原文里已经存在；结尾只是重新使用它们。

annotations.label: 01 · 具体细节
annotations.text: “One hand against the cold stone wall” 用身体写出谨慎，不直接解释心理。

annotations.label: 02 · 节奏
annotations.text: “Once, twice, three times” 回收铃声线索，用重复制造紧张，而不是堆形容词。

annotations.label: 03 · 呼应
annotations.text: 光“held, waiting” 把光拟人化，也把它和老人的邀请连起来。结尾是准备好的，不是突然宣布的。

slides.notes: 范文：比较，不要照抄；标出可借用的动作。

slides.title: 铃声还在响。
slides.body: 好的续写不解释结尾，而是让物件自己说话：橘子、铜铃、水面上的光。
checklist: 保持第三人称有限视角。
结尾落在关系的变化上，不要总结。
